title: Built to be reused
description: Shared components, hooks and API helpers live in one place, so every new screen starts from proven parts instead of a copy-paste.

title: Fast from day one
description: Lean state, lazy loading and small bundles are habits from the first commit. Performance is designed in, not patched in at the end.

title: Tested before shipped
description: Critical flows get tests, interfaces get checked across browsers and devices, and every change is reviewed before it reaches users.

title: Clear end to end
description: From the database to the pixel, data flow stays easy to trace. I document decisions so the next developer can pick the work up quickly.
